name: classvr-prototypes
description: Plugins for building WebXR prototypes for ClassVR headsets without a terminal.

plugins.name: classvr-prototyping-kit
plugins.description: Create a working WebXR scene, share it on a permanent link (GitHub Pages, Vercel or a Claude Artifact), copy someone else's prototype from its address, and publish it to ClassCloud as a scannable QR code — no terminal, no libraries to install.
